text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I visited the Shuntaisai executive 
office 
to return the texts I had borrowed 
earlier—

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
—my lord. 
Please pardon me for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
You have come to return the books, yes? 
Allow me to take them.
choice_data_list:
That's an incredible pile of books on the 
floor...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. 
Every last one of these is an offering.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
They were kindly bestowed upon us by 
museums 
and bookstores closing their doors, as 
well as 
by those involved with the Shuntaisai.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Rituals, history, literature... 
The headquarters collects a wide variety 
of texts, but—

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Works chronicling the bonds between 
Umamusume and people 
are a personal favorite of mine to gather.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Two distinct beings crossing paths, 
weaving ties, 
at times overcoming hardship, 
at times seizing their dreams together—

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
To touch upon yet another trace of their 
journey, 
and to truly come to know it...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: Brings me immense joy.
choice_data_list: Then I'll bring some over if I find any.
Then I'll bring some over if I find any.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: ...Are you quite certain?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Your efforts would surely enrich our 
archives even further. 
...You have my gratitude for your kindness 
toward headquarters.
choice_data_list:
Well, it's not so much for headquarters as 
it is for you, Azuma-san.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
For me...? If this is out of gratitude 
for lending you those texts, there is 
really no need.
choice_data_list:
No, I just simply wanted to make you 
happy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after I tried explaining what I 
meant, 
she merely looked puzzled, but—

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. my lord. 
Regarding what you said before, 
I believe I finally understand.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
You possess a truly philanthropic spirit, 
my lord.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
To take action for the joy of all mankind— 
I find that to be exceptionally 
magnificent.
choice_data_list:
N-No, you're making it sound way bigger 
than it is...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: Fufu, there is no need for false modesty.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had completely misunderstood on a 
grand, sweeping scale, 
leaving me feeling rather tickled and 
bashful.
